jp: \t\t情報が克明に記述された紙片。身長体重は勿論、特徴等も細かく書かれているが、そういった情報収集的に使われることは少なく、艶のある材質も手伝って専らは収集用や遊戯用に用いられているという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t情報が克明に記述された紙片。身長体重は勿論、特徴等も細かく書かれているが、そういった情報収集的に使われることは少なく、艶のある材質も手伝って専らは収集用や遊戯用に用いられているという。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: A piece of paper on which information is clearly described. It contains detailed descriptions of height and weight as well as characteristics, but it is rarely used for collecting such information and is said to be used exclusively for collecting and playing with, helped by its shiny material.  \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "A piece of paper on which information is clearly described. It contains detailed descriptions of height and weight as well as characteristics, but it is rarely used for collecting such information and is said to be used exclusively for collecting and playing with, helped by its shiny material.  \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Un foglietto su cui le informazioni sono descritte per filo e per segno: altezza e peso, s'intende, ma anche i tratti particolari, scritti nei minimi dettagli. Eppure per raccogliere informazioni non si usa quasi mai; complice il materiale lucido, pare che serva soltanto da collezione e da gioco.  \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t犠牲者の生き写しとも思える程、精巧に作られた像。その姿は今にも動き出しそうなほどに生気を孕んでいる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t犠牲者の生き写しとも思える程、精巧に作られた像。その姿は今にも動き出しそうなほどに生気を孕んでいる。\n#～ルミエスト美術目録～\n"
en: The statues are so elaborately crafted that they seem to be living replicas of their victims. The figure is so lifelike that it looks as if it could start moving at any moment. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~
en_grezzo: "The statues are so elaborately crafted that they seem to be living replicas of their victims. The figure is so lifelike that it looks as if it could start moving at any moment. \n# ~Lumiest Art Catalogue~"
it: Una statua fatta con tale finezza da sembrare il ritratto vivente della vittima. La figura è così piena di vita che pare stia per muoversi da un momento all'altro. \n# ~Catalogo d'Arte di Lumiest~

jp: \t\t敵を破砕した際に飛び散った生物の骨片。特に価値はないが水薬や呪術に使用できる為、そこそこの値で売れる。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t敵を破砕した際に飛び散った生物の骨片。特に価値はないが水薬や呪術に使用できる為、そこそこの値で売れる。\n#～私の愛する幾千ものガラクタ～\n"
en: Bone fragments of a shattered creature. It is not particularly valuable, but can be used for medicine and sorcery, so it can be sold for a modest price. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~
en_grezzo: "Bone fragments of a shattered creature. It is not particularly valuable, but can be used for medicine and sorcery, so it can be sold for a modest price. \n#~Thousands of pieces of Junk I love~"
